summary.plain: A few months after finding the W boson, UA1 spotted its heavier, electrically neutral cousin: the Z boson, seen as pairs of electrons or muons whose combined mass clustered around 95 GeV.
summary.technical: UA1 Collaboration, Phys. Lett. B 126 (1983) 398-410; four e+e- pairs and one mu+mu- pair with invariant mass around 95 GeV/c^2, interpreted as Z0 -> l+ l-.

title: Experimental Observation of Lepton Pairs of Invariant Mass Around 95 GeV/c^2 at the CERN SPS Collider
why_it_matters: The first direct observation of the Z boson, the neutral carrier of the weak force, completing the experimental confirmation of the electroweak theory's predicted force carriers alongside the W.
